sources.entry: andrej-karpathy-skills by multica-ai - A drop-in CLAUDE.md distilling four behavioral guidelines for LLM-assisted coding into Claude Code — a low-friction quick win. Karpathy-inspired, derived from Andrej Karpathy's public notes on LLM coding pitfalls and authored by multica-ai.

summary.one_liner: A single CLAUDE.md file of four behavioral guidelines, derived from Andrej Karpathy's notes on LLM coding pitfalls, meant to make Claude Code make fewer wrong assumptions and overcomplicated changes.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides a CLAUDE.md file containing four behavioral principles for LLM-assisted coding: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, and Goal-Driven Execution. Each principle is described with short bullet rules, such as stating assumptions, avoiding speculative features and abstractions, not editing unrelated code or comments, and turning tasks into verifiable tests or success criteria. The README explains the problems it targets, quoting Karpathy's observations about models making silent assumptions and bloating code. It offers installation as a Claude Code plugin or by copying or appending the file to a project's CLAUDE.md. A committed Cursor project rule (.cursor/rules/karpathy-guidelines.mdc) and a CURSOR.md guide are also included. The README suggests merging the guidelines with project-specific instructions and notes a tradeoff: the caution bias may be unnecessary for trivial tasks.
use_cases: Adding behavioral guardrails to Claude Code in a project
Reducing overcomplicated or bloated code generated by an LLM
Keeping AI-generated diffs minimal and free of drive-by refactors
Getting an agent to ask clarifying questions before implementing
Structuring LLM tasks around tests-first success criteria
Applying the same guidelines to Cursor projects
how_to_run: From within Claude Code, run: /plugin marketplace add forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills
Alternatively, for a new project: curl -o CLAUDE.md <URL from README> (the URL is not shown in the provided text)
Or, to append to an existing project: echo "" >> CLAUDE.md and then curl the file and append it to CLAUDE.md (URL not shown in the provided text)
notable: Four principles mapped to specific LLM failure modes quoted from Karpathy's post
Plugin install via Claude Code marketplace or a single-file CLAUDE.md drop-in
Includes a committed Cursor rule so the same guidelines apply in Cursor
Explicit tradeoff note that the caution bias should be relaxed for trivial tasks
Designed to be merged with project-specific sections rather than used alone
caveats: Guidelines bias toward caution, which can slow trivial tasks; the README asks users to use judgment
Effectiveness is described qualitatively; the README offers no measured results
Install commands for the CLAUDE.md option are partly missing from the provided text
